subject: Aligning a rotating demo cadence across US / EU / APAC — proposed slots
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@medilytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling technical deep-dive — rotating demo windows (US/EU/APAC)

Hi Oliver —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery: Medilytics is evaluating inference latency improvements and predictable throughput for your analytics pipelines; you flagged production SLAs and the need for a timeboxed technical deep-dive with your infra lead.

To make this repeatable for your distributed team (US / EU / APAC) we recommend running the tech deep-dive as a rotating weekly slot so participants in each region get at least one reasonably local hour over a 3-week cycle. Attached is a short matrix (ROTATION_PROPOSAL.xlsx) and a one-page outline of the agenda.

Proposed rotation (high level) — please pick the option that works best for your core attendees:
- Option A — 3-week cycle (balanced local times):
  • Week 1 (US-focused): 10:00 PT / 19:00 CET / 02:00 SGT (next day)
  • Week 2 (EU-focused): 08:00 PT / 17:00 CET / 00:00 SGT
  • Week 3 (APAC-focused): 06:00 PT / 15:00 CET / 23:00 SGT
- Option B — 2-week swing (US/EU + APAC alternating):
  • Week A: 09:00 PT / 18:00 CET / 01:00 SGT
  • Week B: 07:00 PT / 16:00 CET / 23:00 SGT

I realize some of those map to late-night for one region — the goal is fairness and predictability. If you prefer a different anchor (earlier APAC friendly or later EU friendly) tell us and we can rebalance.

Next steps:
1) Confirm which option (A or B) you prefer or tell us your constraints.
2) Share the names/emails of the folks who must attend (please include your infra/tech lead).
3) We'll create a recurring demo series with rotating invites and a shared agenda doc.

Calendar options: https://cal.redwood.com/marcus/medilytics-demo (pick a provisional slot and we’ll adjust).

Attachment: ROTATION_PROPOSAL.xlsx (matrix + suggested week-by-week times)

Thanks — happy to call out a couple of concrete slots if that speeds things up.

Best,
Marcus Lin

Proposed mechanics:
- Create a recurring meeting series with two alternating invites (Week A / Week B) and a shared agenda in the Drive link below.
- We’ll add buffer notes in the invite for recording and quick follow-ups so teammates who can’t attend can watch a 15–20m clip.
